title: Cocktails & Canvases at 122 | Holiday Margarita Edition
seo_title: Cocktails & Canvases Holiday Margarita Edition in Joplin
description: Cocktails & Canvases at 122 is a guided painting class with a holiday margarita theme, and no experience is needed. Your ticket includes all painting supplies, instruction, and a charcuterie cup, while cocktails from The 122 Lounge are sold separately. It runs Wednesday, December 16, 2026, from 6:00 to 8:30 PM at The 122 Lounge, 122 S Main St in Joplin, MO; arrive at 6 PM, painting begins at 6:15, and only 15 seats are available, so register through the ticket form.
address: 122 S Main St, Joplin, MO 64801-2306, United States, Joplin, MO
